detailed_descriptions_html.en:
A fusion of splatter-based combat from games like Splatoon and FPS classics like Doom and Quake, ALTEREDBLOOD+ (AB+) is a Movement-FPS-Platformer where Splattered BLOOD is a resource and Positioning is vital to staying alive.

Cover arena walls and floors in your foe’s BLOOD. Soak up BLOOD to regenerate Ammo and Health. Stand in that BLOOD to ALTER Yourself and your Weapons.

Bring directionality to your ultra-violence: Deal damage to Splatter their BLOOD over the surfaces directly behind and around them.

Kill, and they burst into a shower of Gibs, spreading more BLOOD for your exploitation.

Soak up BLOOD by Sliding, Dashing and Stomping on BLOOD Splatter. 

Soaking up BLOOD gives you Health and Ammo, keeping you in the fight.

Watch where you stand: Weapons become ALTERED when you stand in BLOOD, gaining powerful effects to dominate your foes. Each weapon comes with its own unique interaction with BLOOD and Movement; master and push them to their limits.

YOU move through MOTHER, as though a part of HER.

Pass through obstacles like Liquid, fight faster, leap higher. You become ALTERED when standing in BLOOD.

Traverse MOTHER’s depths by B-hopping, Air-Strafing, Surfing, Trimping, Rocket jumping and more.

Inspired by movement tech in classic FPS, ALTEREDBLOOD+ features a range of movement mechanics to learn and master.

Customise your movement experience: CLASSIC and MODERN Air-Control settings are available.

GAMEMODES

STORY MISSIONS

Embody her REAPER

Play through the Missions of AB+, discover new weapons, encounter new enemies, and learn the ways of the ALTERED as you progress. 

From claustrophobic encounters to massive scapes. B-hop, rocket jump, and fight your way through MOTHER.

SURVIVAL <GRAVEKEEPER> MODE

Push AB+’s combat to its limits. Unlock weapons in Story missions before bringing the Fight to relentless waves in Gravekeeper Mode.

Gravekeeper mode features a set of Survival levels. Spill blood, Feed MOTHER, survive.

All game modes come with Friends & Global Leaderboards
